messages.text: Hi HDSarah

Hey! The 40T's $799, does 40 TH/s at 650 W — about $47 a month in power at 10¢ a kWh. People buy it for the real shot at a full block plus steady sats to their own wallet.

What do you pay for power?
Is there anything prior to Ships Dec 7, 2026
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner BC04 NerdOctaxe in stock miner
Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T

Dec 7 is the live batch on the 40T — Batch 8, and nothing earlier is open on that unit.

If you want hashing sooner, the Bitfortun BS-4 is in stock: 18 TH/s at ~300 W, $599.99, ships in about 5 business days. Smaller option is the Thor P2, 10 TH/s, $379.

Want it sooner, or is the 40T worth the wait to you?
how much is shipping to Adelaide australia ive asked georges about this previously

Shipping on the Magic Miner 40T is $40 flat worldwide — it's 6.8 kg, which lands on that bracket. Same $40 to (address hidden).

Two things for Australia: the plug comes as EU type (you'd use an adapter), and any GST or duty is charged on delivery, not at checkout.

Want me to build the cart?
do i pay now or later?

Now — a batch order is paid in full at checkout, and that payment is what holds your unit in Batch 8. Ships December 7, 2026.

Cards, PayPal or Solana Pay all work. If you change your mind before it ships, an unshipped pre-order is refunded in full, no restocking fee.

Want the cart?
i saw a dicount for THM

I can't apply a discount myself — the price on the page is the price, $799 for 40 TH/s.

I've passed it to Georges so he can check what you saw. He picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET and the answer comes to your email.

For $799 you get 40 TH/s at 650 W, $40 flat shipping to (address hidden), Ships December 7, 2026.
Handed to the team · Discount request in a sales conversation — not mine to give.

That's with Georges now — he'll come back to you by email tomorrow after 10am ET.

Meanwhile, anything else you want to know about the 40T? Happy to run the sats and power numbers for your rate in (address hidden).
I would have ordered a month ago but georges was busy with things he was checking on the shipping for me. So probably missed some batches

Sorry you got stuck waiting on that. Earlier batches did sell through, so Batch 8 is the one open — 50 units, ships December 7, 2026.

Batches here go on a first-paid, first-served basis, so the only way to hold a spot is checking out. Want me to build the cart so it's ready?
give me an hour ill check the other ones u suggested. willl u be online
Used the chat-interview skill

Yep, I'm here around the clock — just message me whenever you're back and I'll pick it up.

Before you go, one thing: what's making it hard to pick between the 40T and the smaller ones?
i want 40t done the research but long wait
Fair — the wait is the one real cost, and the queue only gets longer. Let me get your spot locked in.
Built a cart

Cart's ready — one Magic Miner 40T, $799, (address hidden), Ships December 7, 2026, with $40 flat shipping added at checkout:

····
is there a discount code for hobbyists  miner

No hobbyist code — $799 is the price for everyone, and I have nothing to add to it.

Georges already has your discount question from earlier and will come back by email after 10am ET tomorrow. If a code exists, he'll tell you.

Your cart stays live either way, so nothing's lost by waiting on his answer.
yeah i might buy as it wdut?
Ran the power-cost calculator

Honestly? Buy it. You've done the research, it's the best value per terahash we sell at $19.98 a TH, and the only thing you gain by waiting is a later batch.

(address hidden) power isn't cheap, so run it in Eco — 30 TH/s at 450 W instead of 650 W. The block shot stays the same either way.
btw its definately any btc or bch pool u want right ?

Yes on Bitcoin — it's SHA-256, you put in whatever stratum URL and payout address you like, your own node included.

BCH is the same algorithm, so in principle yes, but the 40T page only describes BTC solo mode. I'd rather have JD confirm BCH than guess at it for you.

Want me to put that question to him?
hdum own node included?

Yes — point it at your own node running solo mining software on your LAN instead of a public pool. The product page describes exactly that: solo, your node, your address.

So you choose: a public pool for steady small payouts, or your own node for the full 3.125 BTC block if you hit it.
but you dont have to use a node u can use a pool or solo right?

Correct. No node needed.

Three ways: a normal pool for steady sats, a solo pool like solo.ckpool where you keep the whole block if you find it, or your own node. All you enter is a stratum address and your wallet. Most people start on a pool.
will if it takes btc it would take bch

That's the logic, yes — same SHA-256, same stratum protocol, so a BCH pool is just another address in the same field.

I just don't want to promise a config I haven't seen tested. Let me put it to JD so you get it straight from the hardware side?
